title.en: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market

summary.en: The OpenAI science blog shares new findings, practical methods, and firsthand accounts from researchers using AI to advance scientific discovery.

title.en: Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls
title.zh: Bland推出Tofu-1，一款用于通话的全双工语音到语音模型

summary.en: Bland has released Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model for noisy, high-stakes phone calls. It is in enterprise research preview, with no published benchmarks, size or pri…
